title.zh-CN: 趣味陶瓷电商首页主视觉

description.zh-CN: 生成横版电商首页主视觉，用悬浮陶瓷产品、超大字标和克制网页信息结构展示一组具有统一角色语言的商品。
description.en-US: Design an e-commerce homepage hero centered on playful ceramic products.

zh-CN.prompt:
创建一张 16:9 横版电商首页主视觉，品牌名为“{brandName}”，主打产品为 `{productType}`，系列名为“{collectionName}”。整体采用极简编辑式网页布局与趣味角色化产品渲染。

背景使用柔和暖粉色纸张纹理。顶部是一行轻量导航：品牌图形、系列、品牌故事、经销商、账户和购物袋。画面中央横跨约 90% 宽度放置超大写产品类别字标，使用深炭灰现代无衬线字体。

在字标前方安排 5 件悬浮产品，从右上到左下形成清楚的对角线。每件产品使用不同但协调的釉色，并绘有同一套原创手绘角色语言，分别表达好奇、困倦、顽皮、害羞和自信。保持造型、线条、笔触和材质一致，呈现手工工作室品质，而不是廉价卡通商品。产品需要有真实陶瓷釉面、细微不规则和柔和悬浮投影。

左下角放置价格、两至三行产品介绍和“{ctaText}”按钮；右下角放置页码与系列季节信息；底部使用极细服务信息条。整体配色包含暖粉、炭黑、陶土橙、鼠尾草绿、钴蓝、灰粉和奶油黄。文字准确、间距克制、产品不遮挡关键界面信息，不出现真实品牌 Logo。

en-US.prompt:
Create a horizontal 16:9 e-commerce homepage key visual for the brand "{brandName}", featuring `{productType}` from the collection "{collectionName}". Combine minimal editorial web layout with playful character-inspired product rendering.

Use a soft warm pink paper-textured background. Across the top, place a lightweight navigation row with a brand graphic, collections, brand story, stockists, account, and shopping bag. An oversized uppercase product-category wordmark in dark charcoal modern sans-serif spans about 90% of the width at the center.

Arrange five floating products in front of the wordmark along a clear diagonal from upper right to lower left. Give each a different but harmonious glaze color and the same original hand-drawn character language, expressing curiosity, sleepiness, mischief, shyness, and confidence. Keep shapes, lines, brushwork, and materials consistent for a handmade studio finish rather than cheap cartoon merchandise. Render realistic ceramic glaze, subtle irregularities, and soft floating shadows.

At the lower left, place a price, two to three lines of product description, and a "{ctaText}" button. At the lower right, show a page number and collection-season information. Add a very thin service-information strip along the bottom. Use warm pink, charcoal, terracotta orange, sage, cobalt, dusty pink, and cream yellow. Keep text accurate and spacing restrained; products must not obscure key interface information. No real brand logos.
